D. An ista formula institutus, quàvis

pere, quamuis non rite sit institutus. id
est, iubetur haberi pro rite instituto,
quasi hæc verba subiecta non essent,

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout. Print shows "pepcrerunt" and "deccedit", kept as printed (possible printing errors). Line-end "succes"/"sione" joined without a printed hyphen as "successione". "Ceruidius" given as "Cervidius" under u/v rule. Speaker marks "D." and "F." kept inside the text. Verse-style lines of the quoted law are set as separate paragraphs. The catchword "fta." is read as "sta.".
